name: io.github.theo-ai-lab/toffoli
title: Toffoli
description: Undo layer for AI agents: checkpoint, reversibility classification, and gated recovery over MCP

packageArguments.description: The toffoli CLI subcommand that starts the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables the gated LLM judge on the deterministic residual; without it every classification is deterministic and the server never loads the SDK.

environmentVariables.name: TOFFOLI_MCP_FS_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Back the recovery world with the real-filesystem adapter rooted at this directory instead of the in-memory sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: TOFFOLI_EXECUTE_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Optional kill-switch. Set to 1 to force toffoli.recover into dry-run regardless of confirm tokens or requested mode.
